title: JAVA Suprema regional reference build
notes: Current regional product page identifies an 8.5 kg Suprema reference build with a Toray T800 carbon frame, fork and seatpost; Shimano 105 R7120 2x12 mechanical shifting; R7170 hydraulic brakes; 52/36T crank; 11-34T cassette; 50 mm carbon wheels; and Michelin Dynamic Sport 28-622 fitted tires. Size, pedals and measurement method are not stated, 28C is not presented as maximum clearance, and the regional build is not assigned to the retained mainland seller option.
